summary: TypeScript is a shared root tool invoked by all three applications and three buildable packages, so the 5-to-6 compiler change has repository-wide validation scope.

findings.title: Run every workspace compiler entry point
findings.impact: The root version supplies tsc to API, mobile, web, contracts, database, and domain scripts. A successful check in only one package would not cover the repository-wide compiler upgrade.
recommendedChecks: Run the monorepo command that executes every listed typecheck plus the three package builds, and treat any newly surfaced diagnostic as a blocker until reviewed.

omittedConcerns: Specific TypeScript 6 breaking changes are omitted because the bounded release excerpt links to, but does not include, the migration details.
The safe-area downgrade in the same PR is not assessed as source usage because only its manifest declaration is supplied.
